results.checklist_text: Revenue Growth: In line with the gross profit growth
results.plain_english_explanation: Revenue changed 17.8% while gross profit changed 16.3%; their growth-rate gap is 1.5%.

results.applicability_reason: Revenue and gross profit growth are comparable for companies reporting both measures.
